policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: O: bug bounty payouts set to increase up to 4x
items.summary: O said it will raise rewards for security researchers for critical findings, with expectations to quadruple payouts for high-severity issues. Signals stronger security posture and increased researcher incentives.

items.headline: O: power-cut pledges for data centers
items.summary: O pledged actions to reduce data-center power strain on the grid and mitigate ratepayer impacts, framed as “good grid citizen” behavior. Potentially reduces regulatory and community risk while supporting future buildout.

items.headline: O: model release notes update (spec changes)
items.summary: O published updates to its model specification (Oct 29, 2026). Release-note type evidence for ongoing model iteration that can affect capabilities, safety, and developer-facing performance.

items.headline: O: resumes frontier training after security overhaul
items.summary: O resumed advanced frontier AI training after a security overhaul following a prior issue, and disclosed a flaw found by agents that was fixed before training restarted. Indicates continuity of frontier roadmap and fewer operational blockers.

items.headline: V: W-7 launch for space-made cancer drugs
items.summary: Credible press reports V launched W-7 on Oct 20, 2026, targeting space-based manufacturing of cancer drugs. Indicates additional manufacturing capacity coming online and expanded application scope.

items.headline: V: multiple spacecraft active; more launches expected
items.summary: Space.com reports V is operating two spacecraft in orbit and expects additional launches soon (another in coming days and several next year). Supports evidence of cadence and scaling of in-space manufacturing.

items.headline: V: Series D raises $251M to scale space-based pharma
items.summary: V announced a $251M Series D (reported Sep 30/announced in late Sep 2026) to scale its space-based pharmaceutical processing, bringing total capital raised to $598M. Direct financing evidence for scaling runway.
